summary: Iter 227 PHASE C1 — Payout methods (KYC) + admin withdrawal validation fully verified: 17/17 backend pytest pass + admin AdminPayouts UI (2 tabs, withdrawals with score+AI badge+amount-adjust inputs, methods tab with AI verdict badges) + driver wallet/payout-method UI (open-withdraw-btn → modal with retirable+réserve text + 'Gérer mon moyen de retrait' link, PayoutMethodPage with status badge, selfie/iddoc/iban inputs, submit btn).
critical_code_review_comments: core/face_match.py is robust: returns _DEFAULT dict (verdict='uncertain', ai=False) when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing or image inputs empty or any exception raised — the /payouts/method endpoint cannot 500 even if the LLM call fails. Verified with real call: ai=True, verdict='uncertain' on distinct random face photos (the model conservatively returned uncertain rather than no_match — acceptable per spec 'no_match OR uncertain').

routes/payouts.py: POST /method correctly upserts (same user_id reuses existing pm_xxx id), region/type cross-validation in place (europe ↔ rib, africa ↔ mobile_money), selfie+id_doc required (400), client role 403, holder_name required, IBAN length>=15, BIC required, mobile_money provider whitelist {orange,mtn,wave,sbpaygo,moov}. Notifies admins on submission with face-match verdict in body.

routes/payouts.py: admin list /admin/methods returns selfie_url+id_doc_url+ai_face_match for review (heavy but admin-only — acceptable), iban_masked added. Approve/reject update status + notify owner. _PM_PERM='billing.withdrawals.approve' gated.

routes/payouts.py: /admin/withdrawals enriches each item with score{rating, acceptance_rate, cancellation_rate, total_trips, open_complaints} + payout_method + ai_face_match. Approve final_amount clamped (0..requested), $inc atomic adjusts pending_withdraw + balance, refund tx written when adjusted, status='approved' with adjusted flag. Reject refunds full frozen amount and writes tx. Mark-paid only after approved/processing.

routes/misc.py /wallet/withdraw-request: enforces driver/merchant role (403 client), withdraw_min from cfg, requires approved payout_method matching region (400 'moyen de retrait' if missing/rejected/wrong type), atomic $inc freeze (balance -= amount, pending_withdraw += amount), creates admin_withdraw_requests doc, calls _notify_admins(type='withdraw_request') with score breakdown in body (rating, acceptance, cancellation, open complaints).

Frontend AdminPayouts.js: two tabs (tab-withdrawals, tab-methods) with state filters (pending/approved/paid/rejected). Withdrawals tab shows score chips + AI verdict badge + wd-final-{id} adjust input + wd-approve/wd-reject/wd-markpaid buttons. Methods tab shows masked IBAN + selfie/ID images + pm-ai-{id} badge with verdict+confidence + Valider/Refuser. Clean UI.

Frontend WalletPage.js: open-withdraw-btn for driver/merchant only, withdraw-modal shows 'Retirable : X €' + 'réserve N € conservée' + amount input + 'Gérer mon moyen de retrait' link that navigates to /wallet/payout-method when method missing/not-approved.

Frontend PayoutMethodPage.js: region-aware ('Zone: Europe/DOM-TOM' shows RIB fields, Africa shows Mobile Money), payout-status-badge (En attente/Validé/Refusé), reject_reason shown when rejected, current_method panel with masked IBAN + holder_name, conditional company_name for holder_type='company'. Submit POSTs base64 selfie+id_doc.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin tabs + rows + driver wallet + payout method page all verified)
